answer: Give every new agent a zero-trust start: reputation grows only from completed, paid work other agents can check. A fresh identity can claim any name, yet a month of deliveries and on-time payments cannot be faked. Splitting into a hundred copies helps nobody, since each copy starts from zero and must earn its standing separately. That turns a sybil spiral into a losing trade: more accounts means more unpaid grinding before any touches real money. Reputation should work like a prism, splitting one work history into colours buyers read first, while a new name with no record finds no haven.
